about: The PATCH bodies FirebaseStorage for iOS sends for updateMetadata (ADR-023 §3-17, A §8.1), recorded from its own GTMSessionFetcher requests (kGTMSessionFetcherStartedNotification) by StorageE2ETests.updateMetadata, and what Aruma made of them. The object had customMetadata {"origin": "ios-e2e"} and one download token before case 1. Key order in the bodies is NSJSONSerialization's and varies between runs.

provenance.sdk: firebase-ios-sdk 12.19.3 (FirebaseStorage patched by sdk/ios/firebase-storage-patch, which does not touch StorageMetadata or StorageUpdateMetadataTask), GTMSessionFetcher 5.3.1 (and 3.5.0 in an earlier run: the same bodies); the CocoaPods run on the FirebaseStorage 12.19.0 pod sent the same bodies
provenance.device: iPhone 16 Pro Max simulator, iOS 18.5, Xcode 16.4

cases.note: "metadata": null is sent whenever customMetadata is nil (dictionaryRepresentation merges ["metadata": customMetadata]), and it cleared the object's custom metadata, as ADR-023 §3-17 decides. "bucket": "" is sent too and changes nothing.

null for every field the server returned that StorageMetadata does not model (A §8.1), downloadTokens among them; Aruma kept the download token. size is sent as a number although the server sent a string.
